newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel sees 70 bln mark deficit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Waigel sees 70 bln mark deficit in 1997.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel on Friday confirmed that he expected a budget deficit of around 70 billion marks ($40 billion) this year, a huge increase from previous forecasts of 53.3 billion.
"The budget deficit in 1997 will be in the range of 70 billion marks," he said.

Speaking to members of his Bavarian Christian Social Union (CSU) party in Augsburg, Waigel said the government would also present a budget for 1998 that conformed to the constitution and which envisaged a deficit lower than public investment.
Waigel confirmed earlier statements from German government sources. ($ = 1.751 German Marks)
